description: This file defines the OptimizerNodeVisitor class for Twig, a template engine. It implements AST optimization techniques for Twig's internal Node objects, specifically optimizing 'for' loops and print nodes for better performance.
external_methods: trigger_deprecation('twig/twig', '3.11', 'The "Twig\NodeVisitor\OptimizerNodeVisitor::OPTIMIZE_RAW_FILTER" option is deprecated and does nothing.')
trigger_deprecation('twig/twig', '3.12', 'The "Twig\NodeVisitor\OptimizerNodeVisitor::OPTIMIZE_TEXT_NODES" option is deprecated and does nothing.')

classes.name: Twig\NodeVisitor\OptimizerNodeVisitor
classes.description: Final class implementing NodeVisitorInterface, responsible for AST optimization in Twig templates, including loop and print node enhancements based on specified optimization modes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the optimizer mode with validation and deprecation triggers for certain modes.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Handles logic upon entering a node during AST traversal, including entering 'for' loop optimizations.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Handles logic upon leaving a node during traversal, including 'for' loop optimization and print node optimization.

methods.name: optimizePrintNode
methods.description: Replaces certain print nodes with TextNode or BlockReference/ParentExpression nodes for optimization.

methods.name: enterOptimizeFor
methods.description: Prepares 'for' nodes for optimization by adjusting attributes and tracking nested loops.

methods.name: leaveOptimizeFor
methods.description: Cleans up after 'for' nodes are processed, restoring the loop context.

methods.name: addLoopToCurrent
methods.description: Marks the current loop as having the 'with_loop' attribute set to true.

methods.name: addLoopToAll
methods.description: Sets the 'with_loop' attribute to true for all nested loops.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the visitor's priority for execution order in the AST traversal, set at 255.
